title: Kubeflow Pipelines: Cross-tenant execution-cache poisoning / output substitution via a namespace-blind cache key in…
description: Kubeflow Pipelines V1/raw-Argo execution cache does not separate cached results by Kubernetes namespace, allowing tenants sharing the cache service to read or substitute cached outputs across namespaces. This cross-tenant cache key collision impacts confidentiality and integrity of cached step outputs but does not enable arbitrary code execution. The issue affects multi-tenant deployments using the legacy cache service with cache-enabled V1/raw-Argo steps. A fix was merged and released in version 2.18.0.
